moves.label: Trade: Marcus Smart, Tyus Jones, Marcus Sasser, Kristaps Porzingis, Marcus Sasser and others
moves.description: Marcus Smart was acquired by the Memphis Grizzlies in exchange for Tyus Jones, the draft rights to Marcus Sasser and a conditional 2024 1st round pick (GOS own). Kristaps Porzingis, the draft rights to Marcus Sasser and a conditional 2024 1st round pick (GOS own) were acquired by the Boston Celtics in exchange for Danilo Gallinari, Mike Muscala, Marcus Smart and the draft rights to Julian Phillips. Danilo Gallinari, Tyus Jones, Mike Muscala, the draft rights to Julian Phillips and a TPE were acquired by the Washington Wizards in exchange for Kristaps Porzingis and a TPE.

moves.label: Trade: Colby Jones, Jordan Walsh
moves.description: The draft rights to Colby Jones was acquired by the Sacramento Kings from the Boston Celtics in exchange for: the draft rights to Jordan Walsh and a 2024 2nd round pick (DAL own).

moves.label: Trade: James Nnaji, Mouhamed Gueye, Colby Jones
moves.description: The draft rights to James Nnaji was acquired by the Charlotte Hornets from the Boston Celtics in exchange for: the draft rights to Mouhamed Gueye and the draft rights to Colby Jones.

moves.label: Trade: Marcus Sasser, James Nnaji
moves.description: The draft rights to Marcus Sasser was acquired by the Detroit Pistons from the Boston Celtics in exchange for: the draft rights to James Nnaji, a More Favorable 2025 2nd round pick and a More Favorable 2026 2nd round pick.

For2030andlater, continue the latest announced lottery system; the NBA has not yet determined those rules.
